params.name: trade
params.description: Trade to return resolution codes for. A trade is an area of work for which a service is performed, such as _HVAC_, _Refrigeration_, or _Plumbing_. The value of this or the TradeId attribute is required. Parameter is obsolete. Please use TradeId instead

info.name: Add or update resolution codes for a work order

items.docs:
Associates resolution codes with the specified work order. If resolution codes are already added to a work order, you can change them by sending the request.
Learn [how providers can add or edit resolution codes](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCUCP/pages/1688502858/Resolution+and+Root+Causes+Codes+in+Provider+Automation#ResolutionandRootCausesCodesinProviderAutomation-ProcessingRRCsProcessingResolutionandRootCauseCodes) in ServiceChannel University.

info.name: Get resolution codes and root causes for a work order

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: Unique identifier of the work order to return resolution codes and root causes for.

items.docs:
Returns resolution codes and root causes for the specified work order.  • A **resolution code** is an action that a technician takes to resolve a problem upon working on a service request.  • A **root cause** is a reason why the problem occurred to begin with.

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the work order to add, update, or delete a root cause for.

params.name: rootCauseId
params.description: ID of the root cause to associate with the work order. Ignore this parameter to remove the current root causes from the work order.

params.name: rootCauseText
params.description:
Comment explaining your understanding of the root cause of the work order.
Enabled for root causes with the `HasFreeText` attribute. The maximum length is 100 characters.

For users who don't have access to asset categories, associates a root cause with the specified work order. If a root cause is already added to a work order, you can change it by sending the request.
Before adding a root cause, use the [GET /resolutionCodes/rootCauses](/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/ResolutionCodes/GETv3_resolutionCodes_rootCauses_subscriberId__subscriberId__trade__trade__category__category__locationId__locationId__providerId__providerId__assetCategoryIds_0___as

info.name: Retrieve asset categories for a work order

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the work order to return asset categories for.

items.docs:
Returns asset categories associated with the specified work order. Asset categories represent a standardized classification of asset types.
***Note:*** Only users who have access to asset categories can send this request.

info.name: Add or update asset categories for a work order

params.name: workOrderId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the work order to add asset categories to.

items.docs:
Associates asset categories with the specified work order. Sending this request replaces the current asset categories.
Asset categories represent a standardized classification of asset types. You can add no more than 5 asset categories to a work order.
***Note:*** Only users who have access to asset categories can send this request.
**Example Request** POST /resolutionCodes/{workOrderId}/assetCategories
